name: Cycle Mark
description: Mark the stage of a foe's technique to see whether it is rising or ebbing.

name: Lunar Brush
description: Brush a hand of pale light across a foe's face to daze it.

name: Soft Descent
description: Land from a height with a slowed fall as if the ground pulled less.

name: Silver Wrap
description: Wrap the body in a thin silver glow that thins the force of a blow.

name: Lunar Pull
description: Pull gently on a foe's whole body so its movements trail behind its will.

name: Lunar Rebuff
description: Send an unseen push outward in a ring that throws back all who stand close.

name: Pull Mark
description: Mark a foe's sword hand and tug it a hand's breadth off its line.

name: Push Ring
description: Ring the user with a push that nudges thrown weapons away.

name: Tide Lean
description: Lean into a pull and let it carry the body a long pace.

name: Heavy Hour
description: Make the air near a foe feel thick so its arms drag.

name: Pull Count
description: Count the pulls acting on a place to tell where something large moves.

name: Dragging Tide
description: Let a strong tide drag a foe backward step by step.

name: Surge Push
description: Release a surge of pull and push that sweeps foes across the floor.

name: Disc Guard
description: Raise a bright disc of qi that shields the chest.

name: Glare Flick
description: Flick a cold glare from the disc into a foe's eyes.

name: Disc Throw
description: Spin the disc edge first at a foe's arm.

name: Echo Glow
description: Let the disc's glow return what lies beyond a corner.

name: Turn Away
description: Turn the disc's face so a spear slides off.

name: Soft Return
description: Send a weak blow back to its sender in a pale flash.

name: Polished Mirror
description: Polish the disc to a perfect face that returns a strong blow to its sender.

name: Dazzle Disc
description: Hold the disc so a foe cannot tell which of many images is the user.

name: Phase Turn
description: Turn a foe's rising strike to its low phase and sap the force.

name: Early Phase
description: Move a recovering ally one step forward in the cycle of rest and strength.

name: Old Phase
description: Push a foe's newly gathered qi back to its thin first phase.

name: Cycle Sense
description: Read where a person or tool stands in its cycle of change.

name: Quickened Turn
description: Speed a natural change such as the ripening of fruit or the setting of a splint by a season.

name: Backward Turn
description: Wind a taint back through its cycle until the poisoned ally is as before the dose.

name: Dormant Prod
description: Prod a sleeping channel in an ally and set a thread of qi moving along it.

name: Seed Wake
description: Rouse the bud of a talent sleeping in an ally with slow rhythmic pulses.

name: Dormant Mark
description: Find which part of an ally's body holds unused power.

name: Quiet Lift
description: Lift an ally's flagging spirit with a soft pulse of pale light.

name: Hidden Strike
description: Strike out of a pale glow the foe did not mark.

name: Stirred Array
description: Stir a dormant formation so its lines glow and its guard wakes.

name: Surfacing Gaze
description: Bring hidden bonds and sealed things to the surface of the user's sight within a short reach.
